create_MixUp_augmentation: create a MixUp instance to apply mixup or cutmix data augmentation on a batch of video tensors and targets
run_mixup_on_batch: run the MixUp callable on a batch of input tensors and class targets to get mixed outputs
convert_targets_to_one_hot: convert class label indices to one-hot encoded tensors using convert_to_one_hot with configurable on and off values
generate_cutmix_bbox: generate random bounding box coordinates for cutmix augmentation using get_cutmix_bbox with lambda correction
compute_mixup_target: compute a mixed target tensor with label smoothing using mixup_target given class labels and a lambda ratio
